name: DaffyLevel02_Update
comment: void __thiscall DaffyLevel02_Update(DaffyLevel02 *this) -- Vtable slot +4; switch on state(+0x7c). State 0 (debounce): moves to state 4 unless this frame is a fresh Cross press (g_padCurButtons/g_padPrevButtons, active-low, mask 0x57eb94). State 2 (game): - Not running (+0xdc==0): face the Wolf. Running and the Wolf not in startBox: detectResult(+0xb6) = DaffyLevel02_DetectWolf, and startBoxTimer(+0xb8) = 0. - Wolf in startBox and armed (+0xe0): start the game (running = 1, armed = 0, rot = spawnRot, timer 0). - Otherwise, Wolf in goalBox while running: stop, talkPhase 7, SetState(0), freeze the Wolf, anim 8 once, voice +0xc0 = 0x14 (Lvl-02) / 0x1e (Lvl-03). - Otherwise, running and the Wolf has left activationBox: cancel (running = 0, armed = 0, sweep angles zeroed, talkPhase 2). - Otherwise, while running: the start-box nag. After startBoxTimeout (+0xbc) ms inside startBox, once per stay (+0xf4): freeze the Wolf, talkPhase 9, SetState(4), voice 0x16. - Then the detectResult reaction (switch on +0xb6): 1 heard -> phase 3, voice 0x10/0x1c. 2 moved or 3 seen -> SetState(0) and freeze the Wolf. If the Wolf is carrying a sheep (Wolf msg 0x409): phase 4/5, timeout 3000 ms, voice 0x11/0x12 (Lvl-02) or 0x1d. Otherwise phase 6, timeout 7000 ms, voice 0x13/0x1d. Timer += g_dtMs. State 4 (talk): - curText = string(CINETEXT + talkPhase). Lip sync (anim 0x24 closed / 0xF talking) when no cinematic or 0x6ddf10 bit0 is set, and the game is not running. - Phases 0/1, when the cinematic has finished (0x71c454): on the first one, cineIndex(+0xb5) = 1, freeze the Wolf, phase 2. Otherwise phase 8, voice 0x15/0x22, introDone(+0xe4) = 1, armed = 1, SetState(2). - Phase 2: Ui_DrawTextBox(curText, textBoxRect) with the Yes/No confirm. On a Cross edge with the box fitting: choice 0 -> phase 2, SetState(2), unfreeze. Choice non-zero -> unfreeze; if not introDone, phase 1 and Cine_Start(&g_cinePlayer, cine[cineIndex], cineFlags, cineBox, cineSheepBox, string(CINETEXT+1), 0); else phase 8, introDone, armed, SetState(2). - Phases 3..6: face the Wolf and Dialogue_Say(curText, voice). At the end: unfreeze, SetState(2), timer 0, running 0, armed 1, detectResult 0, phase 8, voice 0x15/0x22, sweep angles 0. - Phase 7: DaffyLevel02_SayGoalReached. - Phases 8 and 9: Dialogue_Say, then unfreeze and SetState(2). State 5 (wait): with no cinematic, the Wolf in cineBox (XZ) and Wolf msg 0x41E (flying) returning 0 -> SetState(4), phase 0, Cine_Start(cine[cineIndex], cineFlags, cineBox, cineSheepBox, string(CINETEXT), 0). Faces the Wolf. State 10: Dialog_Update(&dialog +0x108): 2 -> SetState(0xB), 1 -> SetState(2). State 11: lip sync (phase>1 and not running); Dialog_UpdateAnswer(&dialog, &answerVoices +0xc4); 0 -> SetState(2). State 12: Dialogue_Say(string(textBurnt), voice 0xD, this, 0). At the end: unfreeze, burnt(+0xec) = 0, SetState(savedState +0x7d); lip sync. ScnBody_AdvanceAnim runs only while the game is not running.

name: DaffyLevel02_SayGoalReached

Each frame it sets yaw(+0x16) = atan2(Wolf - Daffy)+0x800, then Dialogue_Say(curText +0xb0, voice +0xc0, this, 1). When done: rot = spawnRot(+0xf8); if wolfFrozen(+0xf0), sends Wolf msg 0xF and stores !result; SetState(2); talkPhase = 2; challengeWon(+0xe8) = 1; startBoxTimer(+0xb8) = 0. The game is not re-armed.

name: DaffyLevel02_DetectWolf
comment: u8 __thiscall DaffyLevel02_DetectWolf(DaffyLevel02 *this) -- Returns 0 if Wolf msg 0x40D (dead) is set. Returns 1 ('heard') if Wolf msg 0x403 (noisy) is non-zero, with no position test at all. Otherwise, if the Wolf is inside activationBox (+0x88, 3D): - yawToWolf(+0xae) = atan2+0x800. It calls DaffyLevel02_UpdateHeadSweep and DaffyLevel02_DrawAlertIcon. - relAngle(+0xac) = (yawToWolf - (yaw + headYaw +0xa6)) & 0xfff; the Wolf is in view if |relAngle| < 0x38. Because of the mask, relAngle is never negative, so the beam is one-sided (0..0x37, about 4.9°) rather than ±4.9°. - In view, Lvl-02 variant (+0xd0 = 1): Wolf msg 0x404 (visible) -> 3, else msg 0x1C (moved this frame) -> 2. - In view, Lvl-03 variant: msg 0x1C -> 2, else msg 0x404 -> 3. name: DancingGhost_StepToward
comment: Frame-counted motion: when farther than param_4 from the target it computes a frame count N = ((dist<<12) / (speed * g_dt)) | 1 from THIS frame's g_dt, then moves (delta / N) per axis with s16 integer division (optionally rate-limited to +-1 change per frame vs the previous step at +0x148..+0x14c). N is recomputed each call, but the per-axis integer division delta/N truncates toward zero, so at high FPS (large N) small deltas give a 0 step and the ghost stalls short of the target; also an unguarded divide by speed*g_dt (fault if g_dt==0). FUN_00441eb0 does the same for a second mover (uVar2 = ((dist<<12)/(param_5*g_dt))|1). Affects the DancingGhost dance level only.

name: Dragon_ChooseState
comment: void __thiscall Dragon_ChooseState(Dragon *this) -- The AI transition logic, called by Update. **Skipped** in 0x19/0x1a/0x20, skid 8-10, landing 0x16-0x18, take-off 0x11/0x12/0x21/0x22 and the time-machine states (0x15, 0x1b-0x1f, 0x23, 0x24). **Special states.** - State 0x10: Wolf x/z in ZONE -> 0x13; nothing else. - State 0x14: dragon x/z in ROCKZONE -> flyToRockZone = 0, SetState(0x13). **Otherwise**, unless state is 0x14 or Dragon_CheckWolfInRockZone fired, in order: - (a) ShouldFly && !flying -> flyToRockZone = 0, SetState(0x11). - (b) !ShouldFly && flying && !landing: landTimerMs starts at 5000 if -1, then -= g_dtMs. Below 0 -> flyToRockZone = 0, SetState(0x16), timer = -1. - (c) wolfDistXZ < 300 && !firing && Wolf msg 0x40c (running) == 0 && 0x40d (dead) == 0 -> SetState(flying ? 6 : 5). - (d) dist < 350 && !firing && grounded && Wolf alive -> SetState(2). A state-7 dragon first waits for anim-finished. - (e) dist < 350 && !firing && state 0x13 && Wolf alive -> SetState(4). - (f) Wolf not in ZONE (3-D) and not idling (0xb-0xf): - Flying, not landing or taking off, and dragon x/z outside ROCKZONE -> flyToRockZone = 1 and, from 0x13, SetState(0x14). The IsFlying check makes its SetState(0x11) branch dead. - Else SetState(flying ? 0x10 : 0). - (g) grounded && !firing: dist < 1280 -> SetState(7); else, unless idling, SetState(0xb).

name: Dragon_UpdateState
comment: void __thiscall Dragon_UpdateState(Dragon *this) -- Per-state actions, table 0x445e5e. 'fin' = anim.flags & 8. **Ground states.** - 0 and 0x10: FaceTarget(Wolf). - 1: fin -> 0. - 2: face; fin -> IsWolfInFireReach ? 1 : 0. - 3: fin -> 0x13. - 4: face; fin -> reach ? 3 : 0x13. - 5: face, BackAwayFromWolf; fin -> 0. - 6: face, BackAwayFromWolf; fin -> 0x13. - 7: face. If the Wolf runs and runLatch is 0 at fin -> runLatch = 1, anim 2 loop. If the Wolf stopped and runLatch is set at fin -> runLatch = 0, anim 1 loop. Then MoveToTarget(runLatch ? 1200 : 600). **Skid and idle.** - 8: UpdateSkid()==0 || fin -> 9. - 9: the same -> 10. - 10: UpdateSkid()==0 && fin -> 0. - 0xc: fin -> 0xd. - 0xd: fin -> idleLoopsLeft--; at 0 -> 0xe. - 0xe: fin -> 0. - 0xf: fin -> idleLoopsLeft--; at 0 -> 0. **Flight.** - 0x11: fin -> 0x12. - 0x12: VerticalMove(1) || fin -> flyToRockZone ? 0x14 : 0x13. - 0x13: face. At fin, runLatch = Wolf running and anim 9 restarts in both cases. MoveToTarget(600). - 0x14: FaceTarget(rockZoneTarget), MoveToTarget(1800). - 0x16: fin -> 0x17. - 0x17: VerticalMove(0) -> 0x18. - 0x18: fin -> 0. **Intro.** - 0x19: face; Wolf x/z in boxFirstContact -> 0x1a. - 0x1a: when g_cinePlayer.active (0x71c450) == 0 -> SnapToGround(1), 0. **Time machine.** - 0x15: FaceTarget(sphereTarget); ApproachSphere() -> 0x1d, which never happens. - 0x1b: ApproachSphere() -> 0x1c, which never happens. - 0x1c and 0x1d: fin -> 0x1e. - 0x1f: fin -> 0x20. - 0x20: cine inactive -> 0x25. - 0x21: fin -> 0x22. - 0x22: VerticalMove(1) || fin -> 0x15. - 0x23: TimeMachine_IsInPresent(Wolf) -> 0. - 0x24: TimeMachine_IsInPresent(Wolf) -> savedState (+0x271). 0xb and 0x1e do nothing.

name: Dragon_SetState
comment: void __thiscall Dragon_SetState(Dragon *this, u8 state) -- Returns if state == current. Otherwise state (+0x270) = new, runLatch (+0x98) = 0, then table 0x446b53. Anims are started with Anim_Start(&inst, &anim, id, loop?1:0). **Ground and fire.** - 0: anim 7 loop. - 1: if Wolf msg 0x40d == 0, Wolf msg 0x35 (burn -> WOLF_ST_BURNT 0x9F); anim 0xd. - 2: anim 0xc. - 3: msg 0x35 as in 1; anim 0x19. - 4: anim 0x15. - 5: anim 1. - 6: anim 0x16. - 7: runLatch = Wolf msg 0x40c (running); anim 2 loop if running, else anim 1 loop. **Skid and idle.** - 8: anim 0xe. - 9: anim 0xf. - 0xa: anim 0x10. - 0xb: Rand_Bounded(5) == 0 ? SetState(0xc) : SetState(0xf). - 0xc: FaceTarget(Wolf pos); idleLoopsLeft = Rand_Bounded(3)+1; anim 4 loop. - 0xd: anim 5 loop. - 0xe: anim 6 loop. - 0xf: idleLoopsLeft = Rand_Bounded(12)+1; anim 7 loop. **Flight.** - 0x10: anim 0x16 loop. - 0x11: flyHeight = 0; anim 0x12. - 0x12: anim 0x11. - 0x13 and 0x14: anim 8 loop if flyToRockZone, else anim 9 loop. - 0x15: FaceTarget(sphereTarget); anim 9 loop. - 0x16: anim 0xa. - 0x17: anim 0x14. - 0x18: SnapToGround(1); anim 0xb. **Intro, time machine and exit.** - 0x19: anim 7 loop. - 0x1a: Cine_Start(&g_cinePlayer, cineFirstContact, flagFirstContact, 0,0,0,0). - 0x1b: FaceTarget(sphereTarget); anim 1 loop. - 0x1c: anim 0x17. - 0x1d: anim 0x1a. - 0x1e and 0x21: nothing. - 0x1f: anim 0x18. - 0x20: Cine_Start(cineChronoBall, flagChronoBall, 0,0,0,0). - 0x22: anim 0x11. - 0x23: PlayAnim(7, loop). - 0x24: PlayAnim(0x16, loop). - 0x25: flags |= 0x800 (SCN_OF_HIDDEN); SetBoxCollision(0). ret 4.

name: Dragon_MoveToTarget

Collision: - Flying states: Collide_ResolveMove(step, &ci, 0xb54, 10, 0,0,10,0,0). If ci.movableObj != 0 the unresolved step is restored, so it flies through movable objects. - Otherwise: Collide_ResolveMove(..., 0xb54, 0xf, ...). Movement: - If state 0x14, or dist >= 350 and step != 0: TryMoveInZone(step). - Otherwise, if the Wolf is not running and runLatch is set: runLatch = 0, and if grounded, StartSkid(step) + SetState(8). ret 4. name: Dragon_UpdateSkid

The halving is per frame, not scaled by g_dt.

Collide_ResolveMove((0,dy,0), &ci, 0xb54, 0xf, ..., 10), then ScnObject_Translate. This move is not confined to ZONE. Returns 1: - Up: when (contact & 7) or flyHeight (+0xc4, += -dy) >= 160. - Down: when (contact & 5) with ci.floorObj != Wolf, or flyHeight (-= dy) < 0. ret 4.

It clears bits 2/4/8/0x20 and sets 0x10. - If g_camMode == 6 it saves g_camPitch/yaw (0x584d28), roll 0x584d2c and g_camDist into savedCamRot +0x2c0 / savedCamDist +0x2c6. - Otherwise it calls Camera_SetMode(6,0) from modes 0 or 2-5. From modes 7-10 it does so only when g_camScriptReturnMode != 6, and first clears g_camScriptFlags bit 2. After such a switch it restores the saved rot/dist into the request with flags |= 0xC and zeroes reqVel. - Returns 1. Otherwise it returns 0. Verified.

name: Robot_GetDropPoint
comment: s32 __thiscall Robot_GetDropPoint(Robot *this, Vec3s *out) -- Returns 0 if TOUCHING_MOVABLE (robotFlags & 2). Otherwise out = pos + dropOffset (+0x2c8, set to (0,-2,0) by Init). It then calls World_GroundYRay(out, 1). It returns 1 only if the ground is at or below out.y and at most 20 (0x14) units below it. Only caller is the put-down state 0xD. Verified.

name: Robot_IsFalling
comment: s32 __thiscall Robot_IsFalling(Robot *this) -- 1 if airTime(+0xc0) > 0x800, or airTime > 0x200 and ground height under the robot (shadow.pos.y +0x66) is more than 200 (0xc8) below pos.y. Callers: GroundControlStep, StandStep, FaceTargetStep, Update (dash state 6). Verified.

name: Robot_CanJump
comment: s32 __thiscall Robot_CanJump(Robot *this) -- 1 if both hold: (a) the ground (+0x66) is within 10 units below pos.y, or airTime(+0xc0) <= 0x111 (about 67 ms of coyote time); and (b) groundNormal.y (+0xf6) < -g_robotSurfaceTuning.jumpSlope (0x57a950 = 0x800), i.e. the surface is flatter than 60 degrees. Only caller is GroundControlStep. Verified.

name: Robot_ScanContextActions
comment: void __thiscall Robot_ScanContextActions(Robot *this) -- The Robot counterpart of Wolf_ScanContextActions. It clears ctxAction.target +0x2a0, ctxAction.action +0x29c and heldActionType +0x2a4, sets ctxPromptExtra +0x2a8 = 1 and itemPromptId +0x2ac = 0x65 (the Robot class id, used as a 'nothing' sentinel). - No held object (+0x284 == 0) and state flag 0x10 set: ScnControllable_ScanInteractables(this, &ctxAction.action, NULL, yRange 0x1e, boxDist 0x1e, pointRadius 0x3c, maxAngle 0x400, 0). Objects answer msg 2 with the robot as sender. - Holding an object: heldActionType = held->msg 0x17, then held->msg 6 with arg &+0x2ac (the item prompt block). Called once per frame by Robot_Update in active states. Verified.

name: Robot_IsContextActionAllowed
comment: s32 __thiscall Robot_IsContextActionAllowed(Robot *this, s32 onGround) -- Filter on the scan result. - ctx 0: held action 0, 1 or 0x17 is always allowed; held action 2 (HELD_THROWABLE) only when onGround. - ctx 1, 3 (ACTIVATE), 4 (PICKUP), 0x19 (WOLFTRAP) or 0x1E (TIMEKEEPER): allowed only when onGround. - Anything else: not allowed. Only caller is Robot_TryContextAction. Verified.

name: Robot_DoContextAction
comment: s32 __thiscall Robot_DoContextAction(Robot *this) -- Runs the action on an Action press. Returns 1 when it changed state. - ctx 0 with held action 1 or 0x17: held->msg 0x15, returns 0. With held action 2: held->msg 0x15 and SetState(0xD) (put down), returns 1. - ctx 1: target(+0x2a0)->msg 1 (use), returns 0. - ctx 3: SetState(0x1B) (activate). - ctx 4: SetState(0xB) (pickup reach). - ctx 0x19: SetState(0x16) (reach into the WolfTrap). - ctx 0x1E: target->msg 1 then SetState(0x1D). Verified.

name: Robot_TryContextAction
comment: s32 __thiscall Robot_TryContextAction(Robot *this, s32 onGround) -- If !Robot_IsContextActionAllowed(onGround), clears ctxAction.target/ctxAction.action/heldActionType. Then, if padBits(+0xd4) & 0x40 (action edge), returns Robot_DoContextAction(), else 0. Called with 1 from the ground states (via GroundControlStep) and with 0 from the fall and jump states 7, 8, 9 and 0xA. Verified.

name: Robot_Move
comment: u32 __thiscall Robot_Move(Robot *this, Vec3s *delta, Vec3s *vel, const Vec3s *rot, u16 mask) -- Common mover for all Robot step functions. - rot (+0x14) = *rot. - If riderCount(+0x11c) > 0: ScnControllable_ApplyMoveModifiers(delta, vel, stateFlags & 0x80, 0, 1). - Then Wolf_MoveResolve(this, delta, &contact, g_robotSurfaceTuning.normalCutoff (0x57a952 = 2900), mask, horizLimit 0x19, vertLimit 0x32, step 10). - robotFlags |= 2 if contact.movableObj != 0; |= 4 if contact.floorObj != 0. - Returns the MoveResolve flags (bit 1 = floor-class contact). The cutoff of 2900 means any surface steeper than about 45 degrees is a wall for the robot (70 degrees for Ralph). Verified from asm.

name: Robot_WalkStep

comment: u32 __thiscall Robot_DashStep(Robot *this) -- ScnControllable_SteerRun(g_sharedScratch, &tmpRot, &g_robotDashMoveRec 0x57a914 (maxSpeed 600, accel/decel 600), runFlag 1). The target speed is always 600 and ignores stick magnitude. Then Wolf_SurfaceVelocity with g_robotSurfaceTunin

name: Robot_TurnToHeadingStep
comment: u32 __thiscall Robot_TurnToHeadingStep(Robot *this, s16 heading) -- ScnControllable_SteerToHeading(g_sharedScratch, &tmpRot, &g_robotWalkMoveRec, heading), i.e. turn toward heading while slowing to 0. Then Wolf_SurfaceVelocity, Vec3s_ScaleByDt and Robot_Move(mask 0). Callers: Robo

name: Robot_FallStep
comment: u32 __thiscall Robot_FallStep(Robot *this, u16 mask) -- Mobile_Steer with the walk record, then vel.y += (g_robotSurfaceTuning.gravity 0x57a95c = 2000) * airTime >> 12, capped at g_robotSurfaceTuning.maxFall 0x57a95a = 1500. Vec3s_ScaleByDt, then Robot_Move(mask), and returns its flags. Callers pass mask 2, or 7 when riders are present (state 1). Bit 1 of the result means landed. Verified.

name: Robot_JumpRiseStep
comment: u32 __thiscall Robot_JumpRiseStep(Robot *this) -- Rise step for state 9. airTime = 0, then Mobile_Steer with the walk record. With t = min(stateTime +0x2b0, 0x4cc): vel.y -= ((0x4cc - t) * 300) / 0x170, which is 1001 u/s upward at t=0 falling linearly to 0 at 0x4cc (0.3 s). Vec3s_ScaleByDt, Robot_Move(mask 2), returns the flags. The rise height works out at 129-132 units at 30/60/120 FPS. Verified.

name: Robot_EjectFlightStep
comment: s32 __thiscall Robot_EjectFlightStep(Robot *this) -- Scripted flight of state 0x12, with no collision. - t = stateTime, clamped to 0x2000 (2 s). traj = ejectTraj (+0x298, EJECTTRAJ = {u16 count; Vec3s pts[]}), end = pts[1] (traj+8). - dx = ejectStart.x (+0x2d0) - end.x, dz = ejectStart.z (+0x2d4) - end.z. Facing = Math_RadiansToAngle4096(Math_Atan2(dx, dz)) & 0xfff. - Phase 1 (t <= 0x1000): h0 = ejectStart.y (+0x2d2), dh = pts[0].y (traj+4) - h0, u = t, horizontal fraction f = (t<<12)>>13; also airTime = 0. - Phase 2: h0 = end.y (traj+0xa), dh = pts[0].y - h0, u = 0x2000 - t, f = 0x1000 - u*u/0x2000. - Position: y = h0 + ((2u - u*u/0x1000) * dh >> 12); x = start.x - dx*f>>12; z = start.z - dz*f>>12. It applies this through vtable +0x1C (SetPosition) and sets the facing. - Returns t >= 0x2000. So it is a two-half parabola that peaks at pts[0].y after 1 s and lands exactly on pts[1] after 2 s. The x/z of pts[0] are ignored. Verified from asm.

name: Robot_GroundControlStep
comment: s32 __thiscall Robot_GroundControlStep(Robot *this) -- Driver for the ground states 4 and 5. Robot_WalkStep, then: - If Robot_TryContextAction(1) started an action, return 0. - If Robot_IsFalling: SetState(7), return 0. - If padBits & 1 (jump edge) and Robot_CanJump: SetState(8), return 0. - If padBits & 8 (run held): SetState(6) (dash), return 0. - Otherwise return 1: stay in state. Verified.

name: Robot_StandStep
comment: s32 __thiscall Robot_StandStep(Robot *this) -- Zeroes stickX/stickY/stickMag (+0xc8..+0xd0), calls Robot_WalkStep (decelerate, gravity). If Robot_IsFalling it calls SetState(7). Returns !falling. Used by states 3, 0xC, 0xD, 0xE, 0x1A, 0x1C and 0x1D. Verified.

name: Robot_FaceTargetStep
comment: s32 __thiscall Robot_FaceTargetStep(Robot *this) -- Heading = ScnObject_HeadingTo(ctxAction.target(+0x2a0)->pos), or the current facing if there is no target. Calls Robot_TurnToHeadingStep(heading). If Robot_IsFalling it calls SetState(7). Returns !falling. Used by the reach states 0xB, 0x16 and 0x1B. Verified.

name: Robot_IsControllable
comment: s32 __thiscall Robot_IsControllable(Robot *this) -- 1 if robotFlags & 1 (CONTROLLED), !(g_gameFlags & 1), !Map_IsOpen() and g_camDebugMode == 0. Robot_Update passes it (and g_camMode != 1) as the enable argument of ScnControllable_ReadPad. Verified.

name: Robot_TakeControl
comment: s32 __thiscall Robot_TakeControl(Robot *this) -- Sends g_pWolf msg 0xE (freeze), with the robot as sender, so the Wolf's grabber becomes the robot. If accepted: robotFlags |= 1 (CONTROLLED) | 0x20 (DRIVEN), then ScnControllable_StopMotion. Returns whether accepted. Only caller is msg 0x3f arg 1, which ignores the result. Verified.

name: Robot_ReleaseControl
comment: void __thiscall Robot_ReleaseControl(Robot *this) -- Sends g_pWolf msg 0xF (unfreeze), with the robot as sender. Clears robotFlags 0x21, suspender +0x288 and remote +0x28c. Wolf_Unfreeze does not check who froze Ralph. Callers: Robot_UpdateCamera (View press), Robot_Update death-anim end, and msg 0x3f arg 0. Verified.

name: Robot_Update

Passive states (desc flag 8 clear): - State 0: airTime = 0; if riders, SetState(1). - State 1: stick and pad zeroed; Robot_FallStep(riders ? 7 : 2). On landing, with !TOUCHING_MOVABLE, no riders and the smoke emitter inactive (+0x142 & 1 clear): SetState(0), the dormant state without ALWAYS_UPDATE. - State 2 (carried): airTime = 0. 3. Active states: ctrl = Robot_IsControllable; Robot_ScanContextActions; ScnControllable_ReadPad(&g_pad, ctrl && g_camMode != 1, 0). Then by state (jump table 0x460b27, index state-3): - 3 (power-on): StandStep; at anim end, EnterIdle. - 4 (idle): loops hum sfx 0x119 into +0x2ce while anim is 10 or 11, otherwise stops it. GroundControlStep; if it stays, stick 0 → NextIdleAnim at anim end, else SetState(5). - 5 (walk): motor sfx 0x97; GroundControlStep; stick 0 → EnterIdle. - 6 (dash): sfx 0x98; DashStep. IsFalling → 7; otherwise stateTime > 0x3ff and run not held → 5. - 7 (fall): FallStep(2) & 1 → EnterIdle + land sfx 0xAE; otherwise TryContextAction(0). - 8 (jump start): WalkStep; at anim end, 9. - 9 (rise): JumpRiseStep & 1 → 7 + sfx 0xAE; stateTime > 0x4cb → 0xA. - 0xA (apex): FallStep(2) & 1 → EnterIdle + sfx 0xAE; at anim end, 7. - 0xB (pickup reach): FaceTargetStep; ctx != 4 → EnterIdle; at anim end target->msg(4, joint 0x13); if accepted, held(+0x284) = target; SetState(0xC). - 0xD (put down): StandStep; at anim end, if GetDropPoint, held->msg(5, {pos, flags=1}) and held = 0; SetState(0xE) either way. - 0xC / 0xE / 0x1A / 0x1C: StandStep, then EnterIdle at anim end. - 0xF / 0x10 (death): with DEATH_FALLS (0x2000) stick 0 + FallStep(2), otherwise StopMotion. At anim end: remote(+0x28c) ? remote->msg(0, arg 8) : Fade_StartRestart(0x3000); if CONTROLLED, ReleaseControl; if 0x2000, SetState(1). - 0x11 (kicked): TurnToHeadingStep(+0x2d6); at anim end, 0x12. - 0x12 (flight): EjectFlightStep done → Camera_ReleaseScripted(this) + SetState(0x13). Otherwise, if DRIVEN, not already g_camScriptOwner (modes 7/9/10) and ejectCam set: Camera_StartScripted(this, &g_camera, cam.rot[0], cam.rot[1], cam.rot[2], &cam.pos, cam.focal, 2, 0x1000). - 0x13 (after flight): stick 0; FallStep(2) & 1 → SetStateKeepAnim(0x14). - 0x14: stick 0; WalkStep; at anim end, ctrl ? 7 : 1. - 0x15 (launched): no code. - 0x16 (trap reach): FaceTargetStep; ctx != 0x19 → EnterIdle; at anim end, trap(+0x290) = target, flags |= 8 & ~0x10, target->msg 1 (spring it), SetState(0x17). - 0x17..0x19 (trapped): shadow.flags |= 2. !TRAPPED → 0x1A. 0x17 at anim end → 0x18. 0x18 with STRUGGLE (0x10) → 0x19. 0x19 at anim end → 0x18 and clear 0x10. - 0x1B (activate): FaceTargetStep; ctx != 3 → EnterIdle; at anim end target->msg 1, SetState(0x1C). - 0x1D: EnterIdle at anim end. 4. After the switch: - If holding an object: held->vtbl+0x1C(&pos) (SetPosition) every frame. - Death zones, unless DEAD or attached (inst.flags & 8): g_deathBoxes (zone list [1] 0x6d0c60) at pos. A hit gives SetState(0x10); box type 0x8000000/0x10000000/0x20000000 → flags |= 0x40 and shadow.flags |= 1, any other type → flags |= 0x2040. Otherwise g_waterZones (list [0]) at pos.y-30 → flags |= 0x2040 and SetState(0x10). - g_shadowBoxes (list [6]) sets or clears IN_SHADOW 0x800. - Smoke, when desc flag 0x40 or the emitter is active: source = pos raised 10 (0x57a980>>1). *(s32*)0x57a97c = 600*163/max(speed,25). Flicker timer +0x2b4 -= g_dt; when it goes negative, flags ^= 0x80 and timer = Rand_Range(0x100,0x400), halved when the bit is now clear. Emitter_UpdateDrift(this+0x120, 0x57a970, &src, facing, SMOKE && phase). - Tint: BURNT 0x1000 → tint (0, 0x1000); IN_SHADOW → 0xC00; the inst flag 0x10 is set in both cases and cleared otherwise. - flags &= ~0x300; ScnBody_AdvanceAnim. Verified from asm 0x45f77a-0x460b27.

name: Robot_HandleMessage

Sender Sam (class 1) with ejectTraj != 0: if a suspender exists it is sent 0xE, then CONTROLLED is set and +0x288 = 0. If TRAPPED: trap->msg 0x2C80 (resets the WolfTrap), clear 0x18, trap = 0. Then StopMotion, ejectStart(+0x2d0) = pos, SetState(0x11), +0x2d6 = HeadingTo(sender). Other senders only with arg 0: SetState(0x10) for FireBall (0xAB), else 0xF, and flags |= 0x3040. - 2: sender Wolf with robot.y in [wolf.y-0x50, wolf.y+0x32] → 2 (CTX_LIFT). - 4: from Magnet (0x42): ScnObject_AttachTo(sender, joint=arg, offset (0,0x4B,0), NULL, 1, 0), then SetPosition(old pos), no state change. Otherwise SetState(2) and AttachTo(sender, joint, NULL, rot (0,0x800,0), 1, 0). - 5: Detach; facing = sender facing + 0x800; SetPosition(arg->pos) unless arg->flags bit 1; SetState(1). - 6: forwarded to held object +0x284. - 0xB / 0x25, if not attached and not DEAD: not CONTROLLED and state != 1 → SetState(1); CONTROLLED and state 0x15 → SetState(7). - 0xC: SetState(0x15). - 0xE: if CONTROLLED, clear it; if the sender is the Wolf, +0x288 = 0 and clear DRIVEN, else +0x288 = sender (suspend); returns 1. If not CONTROLLED, sender is the Wolf, +0x288 is set and +0x288 accepts 0xE from the robot: set CONTROLLED, +0x288 = 0, return 1. - 0xF: CONTROLLED |= 1, +0x288 = 0, returns 1. Unconditional. - 0x10: carry anim; arg 1 → anim 0, args 0 and 2..6 → anim 1 (mode 3). - 0x17 → 2 (HELD_THROWABLE). - 0x18 / 0x19: Add/RemoveMoveModifier. - 0x33 arg 0: clear TRAPPED | STRUGGLE and trap. - 0x3F: arg 1, if not DEAD: remote(+0x28c) = sender, Robot_TakeControl. Then TRAPPED → SetState(0x18); else, unless state flag 0x100, POWERED_ON ? EnterIdle : (set 0x400, SetState(3)). Arg 0: if CONTROLLED, ReleaseControl; then SetState(1) unless DEAD or state flag 0x100. - 0x40: STRUGGLE |= 0x10. - 0x44: arg 0 → 0x100, arg 1 → 0x200. - 0x49: Robot_UpdateCamera(arg). - 0x4C → CONTROLLED. - 0x51 → 1. - 0x6B: when DRIVEN, Wolf_DrawActionPrompt(this, &+0x29c, 0, 1) and Hud_DrawItemPrompt(&+0x2ac, itemPromptId != 0x65), returns 1. - 0x3680 → state flag 8. 0x3681 → DRIVEN. 0x3682 → state in 0x11..0x14. Verified from asm.

name: Robot_EnterIdle

name: Robot_EnterState

name: Robot_SetStateKeepAnim
comment: void __thiscall Robot_SetStateKeepAnim(Robot *this, u8 state) -- Only Robot_EnterState(state); the current anim keeps playing. Only caller is state 0x13 landing → 0x14, so the table anim 0x19 of state 0x14 is never started. State 0x14 then ends on the next loop wrap of anim 0x18. Verified.

name: Robot_ClearState
comment: void __thiscall Robot_ClearState(Robot *this) -- - robotFlags &= ~0x3BDE, keeping only CONTROLLED 1, DRIVEN 0x20 and POWERED_ON 0x400. - Stick/pad zeroed; ScnControllable_StopMotion; airTime, slopeTime and stateTime = 0; groundNormal = (0,-0x1000,0); ejectStart +0x2d0 = 0. - Context block: +0x29c/+0x2a0/+0x2a4/+0x2a8 = 0, +0x2ac = 0x65, +0x2ae = 0. idleLoopCount = 0; +0x2d6 = 0. - Emitter_Reset(this+0x120); flicker timer +0x2b4 = 0; trap +0x290 = 0. - Saved camera: +0x2c0 = {g_camMinPitch, -facing & 0xfff, 0}, +0x2c6 = g_camModeParams[6].dist (0x6e44e8). name: Sam_PutDownCarried
comment: void __thiscall Sam_PutDownCarried(Sam *this, u16 keepPos) -- Drops carryGoal.object1 (+0x908) and, if non-NULL, carryGoal.object2 (+0x90c). name: Sam_IsTargetNearFinalPathEdge

name: Sam_State3_Heading0x1000Bug
comment: The rounded heading is not masked to 12 bits, so a bearing in 0xF00..0xFFF gives heading 0x1000. That range is the 22.5 degrees on the -x side of +z. In state 3, vx = sin[0x1000] = 0 and vz = cosTable[0x1000], which reads the word at 0x5814e0 just past the 0x1400-entry table. That word is 0. Sam's horizontal velocity is therefore zero and he runs in place until the 200 ms stall rule turns him to 0xE00 or 0x200. Later turns are masked with & 0xfff.

The state 6/7 case body with the head sweep starts at 0x467f1a (jump table 0x46b342 entries 6 and 7 = 0x467f1a); asm 0x467f20-0x467f4d: movsx HEADSPEED, 'mov edx,[0x71b2e8]; sar edx; imul eax,edx; add; and 0xfff'. If a label is wanted, use 0x467f1a for the look-after case, 0x466b44 for 'Sam_Update_PrePassSwitch' and 0x467ad7 for the main state switch.

name: Sam_PrePass_UncatchableGiveUp
comment: In the pre-pass for states 1-4, with goal kind 0, target = Ralph, and Manhattan distance 150 or more: if Ralph's handler answers msg 0x419 with 0 (his current move has flag 0x2000000, or DAT_0071c450 is set), Sam immediately calls Sam_SetGoalHome, sets the alert level to -1, and restarts state 3 toward home. This give-up route works in any steering state. Under 150 Manhattan, Sam_TryCatchWolf 0x46433c is tried instead, in any of states 1-4, so a trapped Sam still catches an adjacent Ralph.

name: Sam_Update_State2Case
comment: As stated, with the ground test being a drop test (groundY - samY < 0x65, Y down). Distance gate: +0x8b8 < 0x579 to keep running, i.e. >= 1401 Euclidean returns to state 3 toward the goal.

name: Sam_State2_GiveUpVsStallRace
comment: In state 2 the give-up test Sam_IsWolfOutsideHitZone(0,1) needs the state timer +0x3ac to be at least 200 ms. Sam_SetState zeroes that timer, and it is advanced at the top of Sam_Update. The stall re-route needs the stall clock +0x3b4 to be over 200 ms, and that clock was seeded with one frame's ms. With a constant frame time d, the stall fires on frame k when (k+1)*d is at least 201, and the give-up test passes when k*d is at least 200. The give-up test wins only if k*d equals exactly 200. - At 60 FPS (16 ms), the stall fires on frame 12 (208 ms) while the timer is 192 ms. - At 30 FPS (33 ms), the stall fires on frame 6 (231 ms) while the timer is 198 ms. A physically wedged Sam therefore never gives up in state 2 unless a frame hitch occurs. For example, at 60 FPS a single frame of about 24 ms or more when the timer is near 176 ms would do it. State 1 evaluates its stall test before its give-up test, with the same result.

name: Sam_Update_State3Case
comment: As stated, except the 'ground step' test is one-sided: blocked when groundY(newPos) - samY > 100 (asm 0x46a719 'sub edx,ecx; cmp edx,0x64; jg'), and Y points DOWN, 0x50f650 returns 32000 when no ground. So it rejects DROPS of more than 100 units (or no floor), not rises; rises are left to the collision sweep/stall rule. Stall threshold is 0xc8 ms at speed >= 0x44c, 0x640 ms below; comparison is strictly greater (jle skips).

name: Sam_State3_DeadFiveSecondBranch
comment: The alternative branch jumps the heading by 4*step when +0x3b0 is over 5000. It is unreachable. Its guard local [ebp-0x3cc] is set to 0 at 0x46a688 and never written again, and +0x3b0 is only ever zeroed (at 0x463f82 and 0x46a7bc). State 3 has no 5-second escape.

name: Sam_State3_RerouteLoop
comment: The turn loop when blocked: 1. n = Rand_Range(3,6), one RNG step per blocked frame. 2. Repeat: heading = (heading + step) & 0xfff; counter +0x398 = (counter + 1) & 7; n--. Stop if n < 0. If counter == 0 and the state timer is over 10000 ms, enter state 2 and return. Continue only while the history ring holds (3, new heading) within 50 units (192 when walking). 3. Record (3, heading, step). Turn the yaw toward heading+0x800. Reset the stall anchor. So Sam turns 45 degrees per block (201 ms or more, or one frame at the zone edge), skips headings already tried here, and makes at most 4 to 7 turns per block. The 8-way counter resets only in 0x463e21, not each turn, and only gates the 10 s escape.

name: Sam_Update_State4Case
comment: Same as stated but the ground test is a DROP test (groundY - samY < 0x65 required, Y down), and the zone rejection acts on the first frame (no stall needed), calling Sam_OnGoalReached(1,0) then 0x463e21 toward the node.

name: Sam_State16_WatchRobot

comment: void __thiscall Sam_Pirate_Init(Sam_Pirate *this) -- Vtable 0x57501c slot 0. Props (Sam_PirateProps via record+0x14): JAIL_BOX->+0x80, BOX_NEAR_JAIL->+0x84, BRIDGE_BOX->+0x88 (Scn_GetPropBox); BOX_FORBIDDEN id list->+0x8c, count +0x90; TEXT_IN_BOAT1/2 and TEXT_IN_JAIL strings (Text_GetClassString)->+0x340/+0x344/+0x348; TRAJ_BOAT->+0x178; NBER_OF_COIN->+0x13c. nearJailPos +0xde = centre of BOX_NEAR_JAIL (XZ) at QueryGroundY height, starting from y=-200. TrajFollower_Init(+0x158, TRAJ_BOAT, 250, 0x800, 1, 0, 50); the follower is never stepped afterwards. name: CannonBall_Update

When the sweep is clear: restore frameDelta, ScnObject_Translate, chase camera; a frameDelta of (0,0,0) sets hitDir = 0 and SetState(5). - State 2 (homing, Rook): Wolf XZ < 70 kills with no vertical window. While it is below prevDistSq +0xb0, velocity = (s16)((target-pos)*1000)/35 and the ball translates. Once the distance stops shrinking, transitStart +0x160 = target, the pipe (+0xb4) gets, and SetState(0). - State 5 (explode): explodeTimerMs +0xf8 -= g_dtMs. At <= 0: SetPosition(home +0x7c), launcher +0xb8 and every Pipe/Pipe2 get msg 0x4f with arg hitClassId (+0xbc), Camera_StopShake, reset the 10 emitters, Camera_ReleaseScripted if ownsCamera, SetState(0). The chase camera (CannonBall_UpdateChaseCamera) runs whenever cameraReleased +0xe0 == 0. Tail: while hasExplosionFx and fxActive, the explosion body anim advances and fxActive clears when its anim flag 8 is set. Always ends with ScnBody_AdvanceAnim(this).

name: CannonBall_HandleMessage
comment: u32 __thiscall CannonBall_HandleMessage(CannonBall *this, ScnObject *sender, u32 msg, void *arg) -- vtable +0x10, jump table 0x4a34ea for 0x3381..0x338a. - 0x3381 LAUNCH(Vec3s *dir): launchDir +0x94 = *arg. If the sender is class 97, 146 or 178: launcher +0xb8 = sender, CannonBall_PlaceChaseCamera, firedByCannon +0xe8 = 1. Otherwise camPos +0x158 = camGoal +0x8e and firedByCannon = 0. name: Catapult_UpdateBucketBox

Defect: with catFlags bit2 (THROW_NEGATIVE) set, both max.y (0x4a98b3) and min.y (0x4a9968) get y - ext.y, so the bucket box has zero height.

name: Catapult_FindFreeLandingSpot
comment: u32 __thiscall Catapult_FindFreeLandingSpot(Catapult *this, Box *objBox, Vec3s *ioTarget, s16 maxShift) -- Returns 1 when objBox is NULL. Otherwise it expands objBox by 10 and repeats: ObjGrid_QueryBoxesInRectXZ around *ioTarget. It returns 1 when the rect is empty, when a class 0x6d (CrocodileLevel09) object is there (landing on a crocodile is always accepted), or when nothing solid is found (class 12 MiscStatic and objects without a solid box are ignored). Otherwise the target moves +50 along x (bit1) or z and maxShift -= 50. Returns 0 once maxShift < 0; Catapult_Launch passes 1000 and ignores the result. Only x/z change.

name: Catapult_ScanBucket
comment: void __thiscall Catapult_ScanBucket(Catapult *this, s32 seat) -- The query box is bucketBox with its top raised by 30; bucketCount +0xfc = 0; ObjGrid_QueryBoxOverlap, walked from the end. Skips attached objects (inst flag 8). Takes an object when its model has no box list, or when bottom = firstBox.max.y + pos.y lies in [top-30, bucketBox.max.y] and the object is not the catapult. Accepted objects go to bucketObjs +0xbc[count++]; there are 16 slots and no bound check. With seat != 0: g_catapultLiftDelta.y (0x6cf5f6) = top - bottom - 1, and the object is ScnObject_Translate'd by it when that is < 0 (pushed up) or its class flag has 0x20 (always glued to the bucket top). Objects whose class flag has 0x800 (sheep) get msg 0x2e (MSG_SET_ANCHOR) {bucket centre x, obj.y, bucket centre z, 15}.

name: Catapult_Update

Then Catapult_UpdateBucketArmed; switch on state +0x64 (jump table 0x4aa8f3). - 0 (idle): ScanBucket(1), AdvanceAnim, SetArmPose(armAngle), stateJustEntered = 0. - 1 (operated): UpdatePowerInput, DrawPowerGauge, UpdateBucketBox, ScanBucket(1). An action press edge (0x57eb94) when !stateJustEntered unfreezes the Wolf (msg 0xf if wolfFrozen), stops powerSound and SetState(0). Otherwise stateJustEntered = 0, AdvanceAnim, SetArmPose. - 2 (throw): armSwingT +0x156 += g_dtMs>>3 (cap 0x100); pose = cos(T*0x44 & 0xfff)*armAngle/(T*0x80+0x1000), a damped swing. With a thrown object arc.obj (+0x134): if it became attached (inst flag 8), release the camera, drop it, SetState(3). Otherwise TrackCamera if mobileCamera. step = g_dtMs>>3, boosted up to 4x while arc.t < 0x80. While arc.t < 0x100: arc.t += step; p = c0 + t*c1>>8 + t*t*c2>>15 per axis; delta = p - thrownLastPos +0x144. The move is unswept while 0 < t < 0x80. From t >= 0x80, Catapult_SweepThrown; a hit sends obj msg 0x25 arg 1, camHoldMs = 2000, obj = NULL. When the move is fine: Translate and thrownLastPos = obj.pos. At t = 0x100: obj msg 0x25 arg 0 (landed), camHoldMs = 2000, obj = NULL. With no object, once armSwingT reaches 0x100: SetState(3), camHoldMs = 2000, T = 0. - 3 (arm return): T += g_dtMs>>2; pose = armAngle*T>>8. At 0x100: unfreeze the Wolf, SetState(0), catFlags |= 8. - 4 (launch pending): TrackCamera while obj is set; launchDelayMs +0x8c -= g_dtMs. At <= 0: ScanBucket(0) and Catapult_Launch. On failure: release the camera, SetState(0), unfreeze the Wolf. On success: Sam (the first class 1 object) gets msg 0x482 with obj, SetState(2), catFlags &= ~8.

name: Catapult_HandleMessage

Return 1. - msg 2 from the Wolf: returns 0x23 (CTX_CATAPULT) in state 0 when inside the box (the box pointer is null-checked here), else 0. - msg 0xd (MSG_GROUND_QUERY): Catapult_GroundQuery(arg). - msg 0x1f (MSG_SWITCH_ON): if catFlags bit0 is clear and state == 0, Catapult_Launch. name: Catapult_Launch
comment: u32 __thiscall Catapult_Launch(Catapult *this) -- arc.obj = NULL. Returns 0 when bucketCount > 1: only one object can be thrown. Otherwise SetState(4), launchDelayMs +0x8c = 1, AdvanceAnim, SetArmPose, armSwingT = 0. If bucketCount == 1: freeze the Wolf (msg 0xe) if it is not already frozen. off = power-0x200; d = maxThrowOffset*off>>9 on x and z. landingTarget +0x150 = trajectory P2 + d; Catapult_FindFreeLandingSpot(first box of bucketObjs[0]'s model, &landingTarget, 1000). arc.obj = bucketObjs[0]; arc.t, arc.camera and arc.camParam = 0; arc.flags &= ~1. Per axis the quadratic runs through p0 = obj.pos, mid and end: x mid = P1.x+dx, end = target.x; y mid = P1.y, end = P2.y (not the target's); z mid = P1.z+dz, end = target.z. c1 = -3p0 - end + 4mid, c2 = p0 + end - 2mid. thrownLastPos = obj.pos; update mode ALWAYS. Returns 1, including for an empty bucket, which gives a dry throw. It is called twice per throw: from msg 0x1f and again when the state-4 delay expires.

name: Crane_SetState
comment: Crane state byte is +0x74. State 0 idle: animation 0, cargo pointer +0x64 cleared, rotation restored from +0x80, sfx 0x124. State 1: animation 2. State 2: animation 3, sends FrozenRiver (+0x68) message 0x3E with 1, and attaches the cargo (0x4acfbc(1)). States 3 and 4: animations from bytes +0x75 and +0x76. State 5: animation from +0x77 and cargo release (0x4acfbc(0)). State 6: animation from +0x78. State 7: intro-cinematic wait. The cargo is attached during exactly states 2, 3 and 4.

At the end of state 6 it releases the camera (0x55a30d), sends FrozenRiver message 0x3E with 0, and returns to state 0. There is no g_dt arithmetic. Timing is purely the animation lengths.

name: Crane_HandleMessage

Wolf (class 0): +0x8C x, +0x13C z, animations 0xB to 0xE, and starts the CAMERA cinematic camera. Sheep (class 0xB): +0x13A x, +0x91 z, animations 7 to 10. SlidingIceCube (class 0x4F): -0x117 x, +0xCE z, animations 4, 5, 6, 1. It sets flag word +0x92 bit 0 and clears bit 1 (so the position is applied on release), then enters state 1. The Lvl-08 sheep drop spot is (-11626, -456, -190).

name: Crane_Reset

It then sets state 7 if +0xBC == 0, otherwise state 0. This is the write that places the sheep at the drop-off spot on restart.

While gmFlags & 2: fallTime += g_dt (cap 0x1e000); GroundMine_FallStep(mover ? 7 : 2); clear bit 2 when the result has flag 1, bit 1 is clear and there is no mover. While bit 2 is clear: fallTime = 0, and bit 2 is set if a mover is linked. - State 3 with countdown latch (bit 8): if not forced (bit 4) and Mine_FindTrigger(RADIUS) finds nothing, clear bit 8 and SetState(2), which cancels the fuse. Otherwise Mine_Update (explodes at the deadline). - State 2: if forced or Mine_FindTrigger(RADIUS) hits: fuseDelay(+0x118) == 0 -> SetState(4) immediately; else SetState(3), deadline = now + fuseDelay, Emitter_Reset(fuseFx +0xb8), set bit 8. Then ScnBody_AdvanceAnim. - Any other state: Mine_Update. - Effects: in states 2/3, Emitter_UpdateFade(ringFx +0x124, &ringParams +0x198, pos 25 units up, 0, spawn=1), and Sound_Play(0x96, this, 0x7f, 10, 0x1000) whenever beepSound(+0x11c) is not playing. In other states, Emitter_Reset(ringFx) if active and Sound_Stop(beepSound). - Clears bit 8 if state != 3. Runs the fuse column: Emitter_UpdateColumn(fuseFx, &g_groundMineFuseFxParams, pos 33 units up, deadline - now, 1) while counting down, or (0, 0) to let live particles die. Clears the forced bit 4 at the end. REGION mode (hazardBoxCount != 0), state 2 only: target = g_pWolf if its origin is in a hazard box and in no safe box; else g_pSheepOutOfZone under the same test. If a target is found: vtable SetPosition(&target->pos), flags &= ~0x800 (unhide), SetState(4), so the mine explodes on the target at once. Other states: Mine_Update.

The magnet meanings of 0x51/0x53/0x18 are those used by Magnet_Update 0x4d235e.

name: RollingCarpet_HandleMessage
comment: s32 __thiscall RollingCarpet_HandleMessage(RollingCarpet *this, ScnObject *sender, u32 msg, void *arg) -- Vtable slot +0x10; always returns 0 except for 0xD, and returns 0 for a NULL sender. 0xD: if collBox, returns Box_GroundQueryFlatTop(arg, collBox, &pos, margin 10). 0x1A MSG_MODIFY_MOVE, arg = {Vec3s delta; u16 flags; Vec3s vel}: axis 0 gives riderDelta(+0x64) = delta.x and riderSpeed(+0xb2) = delta.x ? vel.x : 0; axis 1 uses delta.z and vel.z. RollingCarpet_FaceRider. The rider's horizontal delta is then REPLACED by a pull to the belt centre: delta.x = center.x - rider.x, and delta.z likewise; each is >>2 when |d| > 4. This happens per frame and is not dt-scaled. If state is 1, 4 or 5 and delta.y < -10 (moving up more than 10 units this frame, a jump): SetState(3).

name: RollingCarpet_SetState
comment: void __thiscall RollingCarpet_SetState(RollingCarpet *this, u8 state) -- 0 and 1: Anim_Start(0, mode 0), Sound_Stop(motorSound), motorSound = 0, riderSpeed = 0. 2: rider msg 0x18 (MSG_RIDER_ADD: the carpet becomes the rider's move modifier), rcFlags |= 2. 3: rider msg 0x19 (MSG_RIDER_REMOVE), rcFlags &= ~2; if the camera is active, clear it and Camera_ReleaseScripted; timerMs = 0x400; if the rider is attached, riderSpeed = 0. Sound is not stopped. 4: Anim_Start(1, LOOP) for a Wolf rider, (3, LOOP) for a Sheep (class 0xB); if the motor is not playing, motorSound = Sound_Play(0x8E, this, 0xff, 3, 0x1000); Sound_SetRate(0x1000). 5: Anim_Start(2, LOOP) for a Wolf; timerMs = 0x800; Sound_SetRate(0x2000), double pitch. Then state(+0xb4) = state. Callers: Init, Reset, Update, HandleMessage.

name: RollingCarpet_InitBeltScroll
comment: void __thiscall RollingCarpet_InitBeltScroll(RollingCarpet *this, s8 step) -- this is unused (ret 4). IdList_FindWithCount(0x98 = DAV_IDI_ITPDESS_, the carpet-top texture), whose first entry indexes the DAV bitmap rect table (10-byte records {x, w, y, h, texPage}). It fills the global TexScroll at 0x6cfa34 exactly as TexScroll_AddRect does: x, y, w, h, srcX = srcY = 0, srcW = w, srcH = h, offset 0, step, texPage. It then allocates a 0x90-byte backup surface (0x40a140, w x h) into g_rollingCarpetBeltBackup 0x6cfa30 and Blits the unscrolled texels into it. Called once per level load from RollingCarpet_Init, guarded by g_rollingCarpetBeltReady.

Stop humSound, SetState(7). - State 7: - If a follower that answered is inside the cube: that follower gets msg 0x39 and the state goes to 8. The Dragon is tested first. - With no followers: 8. - While followers are pending: followerWaitMs -= g_dtMs. At <= 0, followers get msg 0x75 (give up) and the state goes to 8. - State 8, anim 6 finished: SwapToPresent, then if 0x4000: - Gossamer (if it follows): arrival = its pos. Wolf msg 0x3A. - Then the unfreeze, camera cut, sphere move and VisibilityManager refresh as in state 1, and SetState(2). Finally ScnBody_AdvanceAnim. The main anim id is mapped to a billboard anim {0:2, 1:1, 2:4, 3:6, 4:5, 5:0, 6:3, 7:7}. On change the billboard pos (+0x234) is copied from the sphere and Anim_Start runs with the main anim's loop bit | 2. Then the billboard's anim is advanced.

name: WoodenLift_CarryObjects
comment: int __thiscall WoodenLift_CarryObjects(WoodenLift *this, Vec3s delta) -- Takes delta by value (6 bytes in an 8-byte stack slot). Queries ObjGrid_QueryBoxOverlap(rideBox +0x60). Stack pass, only when delta.y < 0 (moving up): the first unattached object of class 0x8f (FloatingBox) or 0x41 (SmallRock) has its first solid box translated by its pos, with min.y -= 5. Everything overlapping that box, except the item itself and the lift, is translated by delta. Main pass: every unattached ride-box object with class != 0x24 (Wooden Lift) is translated by delta. If its registry classFlags has 0x800 (only Sheep), it is also sent msg 0x2E (Sheep MSG_SET_ANCHOR) with {lift pos, radius 0x14}. Moves are plain Translate calls with no collision test. Always returns 1.

name: WoodenLift_HandleMessage
comment: int __thiscall WoodenLift_HandleMessage(WoodenLift *this, ScnObject *sender, int msg, void *arg) -- Vtable slot +0x10. - msg 0xd (ground query): returns Box_GroundQueryFlatTop(arg, model box 0, &pos, 5). - msg 0x1f: liftFlags |= 1 and dir = dirOn(+0x54). - msg 0x20: liftFlags &= ~1 and dir = dirOff(+0x56). All other messages return 0. Messages 0x1f/0x20 are sent by SuperButton 0x4f8ac8 to its two targets in opposite phase.

name: WoodenPlatForm_PostLoadInit
comment: void __thiscall WoodenPlatForm_PostLoadInit(WoodenPlatForm *this) -- Vtable 0x5770a0 slot +0x00. inst byte +0x13 = 0. Then: - activationZone(+0x40) = Scn_GetPropBox(rec,0) (ACTIVATIONZONE); disabled(+0x58) = (zone == NULL). - bodyBox(+0x44) = model box 0. - door(+0x48) = Scn_GetPropObject(rec,8) (DOOR). - mechanism(+0x4c) = Scn_GetPropObject(rec,0xc) (IDMECHANISM). - targetY[2](+0x54) = -MINZVALUE (props+0x10). - speed(+0x56) = STEP(props+0x14)*30. - targetY[0](+0x50) = pos.y; targetY[1](+0x52) = (pos.y + targetY[2])/2. The CAMERA property (+4) is never read.

name: WoodenPlatForm_Update
comment: void __thiscall WoodenPlatForm_Update(WoodenPlatForm *this) -- Vtable slot +0x04. If not disabled: idx = WoodenPlatForm_GetLoad(), then if pos.y != targetY[idx] it calls WoodenPlatForm_MoveTowards(targetY[idx]). An empty platform goes back to its rest height.

name: WoodenPlatForm_MoveTowards
comment: void __thiscall WoodenPlatForm_MoveTowards(WoodenPlatForm *this, s16 targetY) -- step = (speed(+0x56) * g_dt) >> 12. Moving down (pos.y < target): delta = +step, but it returns early if ScnObject_TestBodyAt(pos + (0,step,0), 4) hits. Moving up: delta = -step. If |pos.y - target| > step, it sends mechanism->HandleMessage(this, 0x21, 0). Otherwise delta = target - pos.y and it sends msg 0x22. DoorMechanism 0x4b428c sets/clears its +0x7c run flag on these. It then adds delta to activationZone->min.y and max.y (it edits the WAR Box resource in place) and calls WoodenPlatForm_CarryObjects(&(0,delta,0)). If there is a door, it Translates the door by (0,-delta,0), so the door moves opposite, like a counterweight.

name: WoodenPlatForm_CarryObjects
comment: void __thiscall WoodenPlatForm_CarryObjects(WoodenPlatForm *this, Vec3s *delta) -- ObjGrid_QueryBoxOverlap(activationZone) and ScnObject_Translate every hit by *delta. Hits with classFlags 0x800 (Sheep) also get msg 0x2E {platform pos, radius 0x1e} first. No other function moves the platform, so it can only move by overlapping its own zone (the platform's own body is a hit). This is inferred from the code: there is no Translate(this) anywhere.

name: WoodenPlatForm_GetLoad
comment: int __thiscall WoodenPlatForm_GetLoad(WoodenPlatForm *this) -- ObjGrid_QueryBoxPoints(activationZone): objects whose origin is inside the zone. It considers only classes 0 (Wolf), 0xb (Sheep) and 0x10 (Rock), and requires the object's model box 0, world-translated, to overlap bodyBox. The XZ test widens each box by 2 units per side; the Y test widens each by 10. A Wolf or Rock returns 2 at once; a Sheep sets the result to 1 and the scan continues. Returns 0 when nothing qualifies. The value indexes targetY[]: 0 rest, 1 halfway, 2 fully down.

name: WoodenPlatForm_HandleMessage
comment: int __thiscall WoodenPlatForm_HandleMessage(WoodenPlatForm *this, ScnObject *sender, int msg, void *arg) -- Vtable slot +0x10. msg 0xd returns Box_GroundQueryFlatTop(arg, model box 0, &pos, 5); everything else returns 0.

name: Progress_ResetGlobal
comment: void Progress_ResetGlobal(void) -- mov ecx,[g_pProgress 0x57b80c]; call Progress_Reset. Called once from App_InitGameSystems 0x401871.

name: Progress_Reset
comment: void __thiscall Progress_Reset(Progress *this) -- printf "\nINFO: GameState cleared\n". Clears: - bitsets +0x84[4] and +0x88[4]; - +0xb0, +0xb5, +0xba, +0xbb, +0x8c, +0x90, +0x93; - +0xb4 bits 3/4/5, then bit 0. Sets +0xb7/+0xb8/+0xb9 = -3, +0x92 = 0x11, +0x94 = -1, +0xb6 = 0, and builds the level-0 path into this+0. Reads 7 bytes, the default value of registry subkey "CfgGame", via Reg_CreateSubKey/Reg_ReadBinary. The key is closed only when exactly 7 bytes come back. On success: +0x95 = b[0], +0x96 = b[1], +0x97 = b[2], +0x98 bits3-4 = b[3]&3, bits0-1 = b[4]&3, bit2 = b[5]&1, +0xae = b[6]. Defaults: 0xc0, 0xff, 0xff, 0, 1, 1, 200. Passes +0x97 to 0x5634c0, which sets g_sfxVolume. Then +0x9a = 0, +0x9b = +0x9c = 1, remap defaults +0x9e..+0xa8 = bfff 7fff efff dfff f7ff fbff, +0xaa = 0, +0xac = (+0xb4&1) ? 0x10 : 0. View distance: Frustrum_SetViewDistance(g_pDisplayInfo, 12000*t + 4000*(1-t), 1) with t = (255-+0xae)/255.

name: Progress_AwardTimeKeeper

That caller also sets Progress+0xb4 bit 2.

name: Progress_IsTimeKeeperDone
comment: u32 __thiscall Progress_IsTimeKeeperDone(Progress *this, s8 level) -- Returns bitset +0x84[level>>3] & (1<<(level&7)), masked but not normalised to 0/1. Callers: TimeKeeper PostLoadInit 0x4f9b90, DoorLevel HandleMessage 0x4b3e8c (door text choice) and 0x43d07a.

name: Progress_LoadRecord

Not re-applied: SFX volume +0x97. Callers: PauseMenu_Exit 0x542bcd and Card_Access 0x54a9c1.

name: Progress_IsLevelDone

name: Level_FinishScene
comment: thiscall(save = PTR_DAT_0057b80c, success). With success = 1 and the current scene +0xb6 in 0..0x1f: +0xb8 = level if its bit in the bitfield +0x88 is not yet set, +0x94 = max(+0x94, level), and the next scene is -3 (-4 or -5 for levels 0x10 and 0x11). name: Progress_StartAttractDemo
comment: void __thiscall Progress_StartAttractDemo(Progress *this) -- +0xb8 = -3. Then Progress_GotoScene(-6) if +0xb4 bit 1 is clear, else Progress_GotoScene(-7). name: Progress_BuildScenePath

WinMain 0x401114 fills the source strings as exeDir + suffix: - -1: strcpy 0x6d6680 "..\Levels\Wheel\Wheel" - -2: 0x6d6578 Intro - -3: 0x6d6468 Scene - -4: 0x6d6db8 Fend - -5: 0x6d69b8 Ending - -6 / -7: sprintf(dest, 0x6d6ab8 "..\Levels\Demos", 3 or 4); the format has no %d, so both give the same string. - default (levels): sprintf(dest, 0x6d6bb8 "..\Levels\Lvl-%02d\Lvl-%02d", n, n). The exe directory therefore becomes part of the format string.

Otherwise: - if 0 <= scene <= 31, +0xba++ (a level-entry counter); - Progress_BuildScenePath(this, scene) writes into Progress+0x00, the buffer Game_ReloadLevel hands to Load_DAVnWAR; - +0xb9 = +0xb6, +0xb6 = scene, +0xb7 = -3; - Game_FreeLevel(); Game_ReloadLevel(). Returns Inventory_GetSelectedObject(). Called by Wolf_QuickInventory.

The front slot (angle 0xc00) sits at (256, slideY+50). name: ItemFly_Stop

Item fly (mode 1 or 2): - dt = g_dt*0x2580>>12, negated for mode 1. - If the u16 t (movzx compare) is < 0xfff: target = matrix(from 0x584c90 via 0x409959) * (0,-120,384) + g_camPos; Lerp_SetVecTarget(&target); Vec3s_LerpToTarget(&0x6cfc44, &from, t); t += dt. - The object's pos(+0xc) is written directly, not via SetPosition, and obj->Render(&g_camera) is called. - Otherwise ItemFly_Stop. Carousel: - wheelAngle = Math_StepAngleTowards(angle, 0xc00, 0x400/s). - slideY moves toward 0 while flags 0x100|0x80 are set, else toward -0x20, at 180 units/s, clamped.

Called by Load_DAVnWAR.

Pass 2: every non-kept item gets Inventory_Remove, ScnObject_AddToWorld(obj, 0) and msg 0x55 with arg 0. In all cases each cached mailbox then gets msg 0x55 with arg 1.

name: Inventory_CommitAtCheckpoint

A composite that answers msg 0x29 also marks both its parts kept. Then g_invAllCommitted = 1. Always sends msg 0x600 with arg 1 to each cached mailbox (at most 6). Mailbox_HandleMessage 0x4d3a3c turns 0x600 into its committed bit 4, and 0x55 into a rollback call to 0x4d35c8.

Picks the sprite sheet &g_spriteSheets[this->sheetIndex] (table 0x6D8078, stride 0x34; forced to 0x6D8280 when altSheet != 0 and sheetIndex == 0), bails when the emitter's active bit (+0x22 bit 0) is clear or the sheet has no frames. It locks the source vertex buffer at g_pVertexBufSrc (vtable +0xC Lock / +0x10 Unlock), memcpy's count*0xC bytes of particle positions, sets world = identity and view = cam+0x40 on the device, runs IDirect3DVertexBuffer7::ProcessVertices (0x6D82D8 vtable +0x14) and then, per particle, reads the 8-byte record {u32 colour; u32 flags} — bit 31 = alive, bits 12..23 = size, bits 24..30 = frame index — clips it against the screen and emits the quad through Draw2D_TexRect with UVs from Tex_CornerUV. name: Cheat_CheckSequence
comment: Pad button-sequence matcher. A shared timer at 0x6d82fc accumulates g_dtMs on each call until it reaches 0x5dd (1501 ms), at which point the progress index is reset. It is called twice per frame, so the effective window between presses is about 750 ms of game time. When the pad is valid (FUN_0055f061) and the current button word (0x719654, active-low u16) is not 0xffff and differs from the previous word (0x71964c), it advances the index if the word equals sequence[index] exactly (no other button or direction may be held), otherwise it resets to 0. It returns 1 when the whole sequence has been entered. Because it uses g_dtMs, the window does not time out while paused.

name: Cheat_Poll
comment: Runs two cheat sequences every frame, even while paused or in menus. Sequence A is at 0x57bc50, 6 entries: 0x7fff, 0x7fff, 0xefff, 0xefff, 0xdfff, 0xdfff. It sets DAT_006d8304 = 1, which has no other direct reference in the asm, so it is dead in this build. Sequence B is at 0x57bc5c, 7 entries: 0x7fff, 0x7fff, 0xefff, 0x7fff, 0xefff, 0xdfff, 0xdfff. It sets g_cheatLevelSkip (0x6d830c); Main_Loop reads that through FUN_0052de40 and calls Fade_StartLevelExit(0x1000), giving a 1 s fade, then g_levelExitFlags |= 1 and the level-exit state machine FUN_00510675. With the button bits in the high byte (jump 0x80, view 0x10, run 0x20), sequence B reads Jump, Jump, View, Jump, View, Run, Run. This is a built-in level-skip code.

First pass counts printable characters (>= 0x20) while skipping the 3 payload bytes of control code 0x01; then align picks the start X (0 = keep g_textCursorX, 1 = left, 2 = centre, 3 = right, both centred forms measuring nChars * font->glyphWidth against g_textWinW). Second pass emits one Text_DrawGlyph per character at the shared z from Draw2D_LayerToZ(g_textLayer), advancing by font->glyphWidth, handling '\n' (cursorY += lineHeight, cursorX = 0) and 0x01 (load a new 24-bit colour). Restores the font colour and writes back g_textCursorX/Y. Returns without drawing when g_textCursorY >= g_textWinH.

name: HoleFX_Init

Stores app(+0x18), vp(+0x1C), useCubicBezier(+0x20), radius(+0x24); centre = (vp->w/2, vp->h/2, vp->zNear) at +0x08..+0x10; alpha(+0x14) and the shading pair (+0xF8C,+0xF90) = 1.0, 0.0. On success: mode byte +0x04 = 1, reads back DDSURFACEDESC2 width/height into +0xF98/+0xF9C (slot 0x58 = GetSurfaceDesc, dwSize 0x7C), creates the vertex buffer (0x538130, MessageBox 'Error : cannot create HoleFX VB' + exit on failure) and builds the mesh (0x5381f4). On failure: +0x04 = 0, allocates a 256x256 format-2 texture at +0xFA4, paints the circular alpha mask (0x53886e), and stores the screen half-diagonal sqrt((w*w + h*h)/2) at +0xFA8.

name: HoleFX_UpdateVertices

Correction to the mechanism: the Bezier control and end points are anchored at the VIEWPORT half-extent, not at the hole centre - only P0 is this->pos - so the rim stays pinned to the screen centre while the hole's origin travels, which is what makes it an iris.

name: PauseMenu_Open
comment: Pause opener (and sibling 0x546515): g_gameFlags |= 0x40 then &= ~0x4001. Neither records the previous value of 0x4000, so exit cannot restore it faithfully.

name: PauseMenu_Exit
comment: Pause-menu exit unconditionally re-enables object update and world render: g_gameFlags = (g_gameFlags & ~0x60) | 0xC000. It does not check whether 0x4000 was cleared by someone other than the pause opener. This is the write that releases Ralph during the wipe.

name: Game_IsPaused
comment: Body is 'mov eax,[0x6ddf74]; and eax,0x40' (g_gameFlags & 0x40, the pause bit that freezes g_dt). Gates the pause openers and the pause-menu update in Game_Frame_2.

comment: void Sound_AllocChannel(u16 soundId, void *owner, u16 *outHandle) -- Voice allocator; sole caller Sound_Play. It tries four passes over channels 1..0x17 in order: (1) The first channel never used, i.e. soundId == 0 && sampleSlot == 0; the buffer must be (re)created. (2) A channel with the same soundId that is not active. If it also has the same owner it is taken immediately; otherwise the first such channel is remembered and used if pass 2 finds no exact match. In both cases the buffer already holds this sample, so no re-create is needed. (3) Only if nothing was remembered: any channel that is not active; re-create needed. (4) If none: steal the first active channel whose StaticSound.looping (+0x24) == 0; re-create needed. If every voice is a playing loop the handle stays 0 (no sound). Finally, if handle != 0: keepBuffer (+3) = 1 for the reuse passes and 0 for the others.

name: Load_WAR

From the right button (0x20) it returns 0x10, except in mode 1 with no used block, where it stays 0x20 (the 'load' button is disabled). From a slot it steps through g_mcardSlotNav[slot][dir] while g_cardBlockState[slot-1] == skipState. This loop has no bound; it relies on callers never passing a skip state that matches all four slots. Callers MCard_SlotChooser (with g_mcardNavSkipState) and MCard_SlotChooserConfirmLoad.

name: MCard_SlotChooserConfirmSave
comment: u8 MCard_SlotChooserConfirmSave(void) -- CROSS handler of the slot chooser in modes 2/3. Left button (cursor 0x10, 'save'): skip = 0, variant (0x6e368c) = 0x10, cursor = 4, then cursor = MCard_FindSlotWithState(1, 'F'); returns 0, which enters the slot row. Right button (0x20, 'cancel'): returns 0x20. On a slot: returns variant | cursor, and Card_StateMachine decodes slot = (value-1) & 0xf.

name: MCard_UpdateScreen
comment: u8 MCard_UpdateScreen(void) -- Called first in every Card_StateMachine tick. Draws Ui_DrawMemCardBackdrop(g_mcardFade >> 1) and Text_SetFont(1), then switches on g_mcardScreen - 0x1773 to draw that screen. Plain messages go through Ui_DrawTextInRect(&g_mcardRectBody), e.g. string 0 'looking for saved game' and 10 'loading data'. Yes/no prompts go through MCard_PromptYesNo / MCard_ChooseOption. The slot choosers use MCard_SlotChooser: load uses title 3 or 4 with yes/no, or 'load'/'new game'; save uses title 5 with 'save'/'cancel'. Results use MCard_ShowMessage plus one of the three footers; the autosave results use MCard_PromptConfirm(string, 'ok'). It returns the screen's input result, which Card_StateMachine tests as bits 0x10/0x20/0x80. Ghidra nests the string-getter calls; they are really the argument pushes (e.g. case 1 = PromptYesNo(str1, str0x26 'yes', str0x27 'no')).

name: MCard_ChooseOption

Draws the title in {24,8,464,70} (colour 0x4bccff), MCard_DrawSlotIcons, left in g_rectChoiceLeft and right in g_rectChoiceRight (highlighted per the cursor's high nibble), and MCard_DrawValidCancelFooter. LEFT/RIGHT repeat (0xff7f/0xffdf) toggle 0x10 and 0x20 with the move sound. Returns g_mcardCursor on CROSS (with the confirm sound), 0x80 on TRIANGLE, else 0. Used for 'save this game?' / 'overwrite this game?' (screens 0x177c/0x177d, default 'no').

name: MCard_SlotChooser

With the cursor on a slot (1..4) it draws the title in {24,8,464,60}; otherwise it draws the two buttons, graying the left one (0x808080) in mode 1 when no block is used. LEFT/RIGHT call MCard_StepCursor(0/1, g_mcardNavSkipState). CROSS calls MCard_SlotChooserConfirmLoad in mode 1, else MCard_SlotChooserConfirmSave. With the cursor on a slot it prints in {24,136,464,80}: 'game N:', then for a full block '%d sheep to catch' (record+0xe) and '%d bonus' (record+0xf), else 'empty'.

It has int3 padding on both sides (0x54d4fa-0x54d4ff, 0x54d507-0x54d50f), so it is its own object file between the memory-card file and heap.cpp. It has no call reference; the only reference is the dword 0x0054d500 at .data 0x57e6cc (file offset 0x17e6cc), which no instruction reads by absolute address.

name: Heap_Init
comment: void __thiscall Heap_Init(Heap *this, void *block, u32 size) -- Calls Heap_InitArena(block, block + size, 4). Only if size > 0x100000 (unsigned; exactly 1 MB does not qualify) does it also call Heap_InitSmallPools(0x20000, 0x40, 0x1000) and Heap_InitAux(0x8000, 0x400). ret 8. The callers load ECX: Scenaric_InitLevelState 0x50d761 passes ECX=0x6cff98 with (g_levelHeapBlock, 0x80000), and Scratch32k_Install 0x54729a passes ECX=0x6defa8 with (g_scratch32k, 0x8000). Both are below the threshold, so the small pools are never set up in the shipped game. Ghidra's cdecl signature is wrong.

name: Heap_Term
comment: void __thiscall Heap_Term(Heap *this) -- Teardown in the reverse order of Heap_Init: Heap_TermAux 0x54da42, Heap_TermSmallPools 0x54d9ff, then Heap_TermArena 0x54d722. It does not free the external arena; the caller does that. Callers: Game_FreeLevel 0x529f5b (ECX=0x6cff98, before it frees g_levelHeapBlock) and Scratch32k_Free 0x54725f (ECX=0x6defa8). In the shipped game it does nothing: the other two are empty and +0x3c is always 0.

name: Heap_InitArena
comment: void __thiscall Heap_InitArena(Heap *this, u8 *start, u8 *end, u32 align) -- Sets up the heap over the range [start, end). - Alignment: a = max(Heap_CeilPow2(align), 4); +0xc = a-1; +0x10 = ~(a-1). - First block: first = ((start + 8 + A-1) & ~(A-1)) - 8, where A = 32 if a-1 < 0x1f, else a, so the first user pointer is at least 32-aligned. - End sentinel: sentinel = ((end - 0x10) & ~(a-1)) - 8. - Heap fields: +0x0 = +0x4 = first; +0x8 = sentinel; +0x18 freeCount = 1. - Sentinel block: next = itself, prev = first, header 0x10. - First block: next = sentinel, prev = itself (the head's prev always points to itself); header = (sentinel-first)&0x0fffffff|2; footer at sentinel-4 = size; sentinel header |= 1, giving 0x11. - Zeroes +0x30, +0x34, +0x38, +0x3c, +0x20 and +0x1c. It leaves +0x14 and +0x24..+0x2e untouched. ret 0xc.

name: Heap_TermArena
comment: void __thiscall Heap_TermArena(Heap *this) -- Empty body (it only saves ECX). Called last by Heap_Term. The name follows from where it sits, right after Heap_InitArena, and from the reverse-order teardown: it is the arena's counterpart, with nothing to release because the arena belongs to the caller.

name: Heap_InitSmallPools
comment: void __thiscall Heap_InitSmallPools(Heap *this, u32 poolBytes, u32 minSlot, u32 maxSlot) -- Sets up the bitmap small-block pools. Never reached in the shipped game. - total = Heap_CeilPow2(poolBytes+1) >> 1 (the largest power of 2 not above poolBytes). Returns at once if total < 0x400. - minSlot is raised to alignMask+1 if it is below alignMask. - Loop (it repeats while fewer than 2 max-size slots fit per pool, halving minSlot and maxSlot each pass): - +0x1c = floorPow2(minSlot), at least 8; - +0x20 = floorPow2(maxSlot), at least +0x1c; - nPools = Heap_CeilPow2(log2(+0x20) - log2(+0x1c) + 1); - +0x20 = +0x1c << (nPools-1); - +0x28 = total / (nPools * +0x1c). - Then +0x2c = log2(+0x1c) (u16), +0x24 = +0x28 << +0x2c (bytes per pool), +0x2e = log2(+0x24) (u16). - Bitmap storage = sum over the pools of ((slots_i+31)>>5)*4, with slots halving per pool. hdr = (bitmapBytes + nPools*4 + alignMask) & ~alignMask. - One block = Heap_Alloc(this, total + hdr) is stored at +0x3c. From it: +0x34 = block + nPools*4 (the bitmap words), +0x30 smallBase = block + hdr, +0x38 smallEnd = smallBase + total. - For each pool i: bitmaps[i] = +0x34 + running offset, then Heap_BitmapFill(bitmaps[i], slots_i) marks every slot free. - If the allocation fails: +0x1c = +0x20 = 0. With Heap_Init's (0x20000, 0x40, 0x1000) this gives 8 pools of 16 KB, slot sizes 0x40..0x2000, 256..2 slots. The effective maximum becomes 0x2000, not 0x1000, because the pool count is rounded up. ret 0xc.

For non-power-of-2 x > 0x80000000 the doubling wraps to 0. Callers: Heap_InitArena and Heap_InitSmallPools. Ghidra's __thiscall signature is wrong.

name: Heap_Log2Floor

Returns 0 for both 0 and 1. Callers: Heap_CeilPow2, Heap_InitSmallPools, Heap_AllocAligned (alignment code) and Heap_AllocSmall (size class, and which bit in the bitmap word to take).
